card.name: Digits in university contact addresses
card.fires_on: Digits, hyphens and brackets inside zip codes and phone numbers in a university's mailing address or contact block, such as a department or campus office listing.

modes.label: Zip codes
modes.description: Digits or the hyphen inside a US zip code after a university street address.

modes.label: Phone numbers
modes.description: Digits, spaces or brackets inside a phone or fax number in a university contact line.

card.writes: It pushes toward school and campus words like university, faculty and student, and away from company and headquarters words.
card.plain: It fires on the numbers in zip codes and phone numbers in university addresses, as the text signals a school setting.
